name: Danganronpa: Hope Recreation+
source:
Play as Makoto Kaedahara, a talentless student who somehow found himself stuck in a killing game. Embark on a thrilling journey filled with deception, funny dialogues, and unexpected twists.

[From [url=https://cirnox12.itch.io/danganronpa-hr]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演毫无特殊才能、却不知怎的深陷自相残杀游戏的普通学生枫原诚，踏上一场交织着欺瞒算计、诙谐对话与意外反转的惊险旅程吧。

[摘自[url=https://cirnox12.itch.io/danganronpa-hr]itch.io[/url]]
